title: 9 Drumaneel, Bridgetown, Bridgetown, Co. Donegal

seller.name: Maeve Conway
seller.address: Block 8 The Grove, Clarion Road, Sligo, F91 A2FP

description:
Ballincastle Property Services are delighted to present No. 9 Drumaneel, Bridetown, Laghey, Co. Donegal, to the market.
This beautifully presented modern four-bedroom home is situated at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, offering a peaceful rural setting while remaining within easy commuting distance of both Ballyshannon and Donegal Town.
The property is available for a short term let of 12 months.
The property is finished to a high standard and offers bright, spacious and well-appointed accommodation throughout. The accommodation comprises a spacious living room, modern fully fitted kitchen with dining area, four bedrooms and two contemporary bathrooms.
There are three double bedrooms, including one ensuite and one conveniently located on the ground floor, together with a single bedroom which would also be ideally suited as a home office.
Externally, the property benefits from private off-street parking to the front, a front garden and a private rear yard.
Property Features:
•	Four-bedroom modern residence
•	Three double bedrooms
•	Ground-floor double bedroom
•	Ensuite bedroom
•	Single bedroom / home office
•	Two bathrooms
•	Fully fitted kitchen with dining area
•	Spacious living room
•	Oil-fired central heating
•	Fibre optic broadband available
•	Private off-street parking
•	Front garden
•	Rear yard
•	Quiet cul-de-sac location
•	Peaceful rural setting
•	Convenient to Ballyshannon and Donegal Town
This is an excellent opportunity to acquire a modern, comfortable home in a quiet and scenic location while remaining within easy reach of local amenities and commuter routes.
No pets permitted.
This property does not qualify for ARP
